scope: Automatic service recovery, durable refresh catch-up, Telegram delivery/capacity, isolated backup/export recovery and CI regression checks.

automated_tests.environment: Local Python 3.12; standard unittest suite with a sandbox-only asyncio heartbeat wrapper. Temporary fixtures and mocked network/model/Telegram services.

scenarios: Crashed service restarts with backoff capped at 60 seconds; cancellation and disabled services do not restart
Multi-day missed refresh deadlines persist all intervening dates and process no more than three game dates per hourly batch
Failed Excel generation retries and clears failure on successful rebuild without advancing source freshness
Telegram 429 cooldown persists across restart; delivery errors survive successful polling
Outbox sends serialized; help/status available at active-command capacity; excess work rejected before mutation
Temporary delivery diagnostic write failure does not kill sender; failed client cleanup and interrupted albums recover on same bot instance
Backup remains independent from grading/notification/Excel failures
Concurrent Excel generation serialized; duplicate download requests bounded; failures/disconnects remove temporary files
Workbook sheet-build failure retains previous valid export and cleans temporary XML spool files
limits: No live Akash deployment or Telegram delivery was performed from this environment.
Publisher availability, current defender assignments and future prediction accuracy are not established by these tests.
Telegram sendMessage has no idempotency key; an acknowledgement lost after delivery can still cause a retry duplicate.
The supervisor restarts failed coroutines; it does not repair a killed hosting deployment or detect every possible hung external dependency.
unchanged: One combined Knicks game-day digest; no additional unsolicited alerts
Existing dataset scope, source freshness semantics and confirmed-settlement accounting
